messages:
oncall-bot: Alert: api-gateway 5xx rate high in us-west-2. metric=5xx_rate, value=4.9% over 5m. paging primary on-call.

samir: ACK, pulling logs & looking at proxied upstreams.

mike: quick check: upstream model-router service responding 200 but tail latencies high. doing a few requests now.

mike: example curl: `curl -s -w '%{time_total}
' -o /dev/null https://upstream-model-router.prod.svc/ping` -> 0.82s, 0.95s, 1.1s. gateway timeout configured to 700ms.

samir: that explains surge of 504s. Traffic isn't failing at origin but gateway is timing out -> clients get 504s -> 5xx alert.

julia: customer impact? lia, anything from support?

lia: support: 12 tickets in last 20m, several mention 504s and retries. one major customer observed transactional retries. marking potential SEV2 if persists.

julia: immediate mitigation options: increase gateway timeout, or implement short retry on gateway for 504s. prefer bumping timeout to reduce visible errors quickly.

samir: suggestion: change pool-B timeout 700ms -> 1300ms for 10m, roll to 2 nodes first. Also silence 5xx page for 40m to avoid duplicate pages while mitigation in progress.

mike: I'll prepare a targeted prometheus silence and a temporary grafana maintenance state.

ops-bot: Patch started: config/api-gateway/timeout-mod by samir. CI checks ok.

ops-bot: Patch applied: pool-B timeout now 1300ms on 2/2 nodes.

samir: monitoring: after config push 504 counts dropped significantly. aggregate 5xx_rate now 1.9% in last 3m. support reports fewer errors.

oncall-bot: Silence created: incidents/api-gateway/5xx_rate 40m by samir.

julia: good progress. need follow-up: reduce alert noise and tune for gateway-specific signals. Proposed post-incident changes:
- refine alert rule to trigger on sustained 5xx + 502/504 dominance (to avoid paging for other 5xx like 500 from internal errors).
- add upstream tail latency panels (p50/p95/p99 for model-router) on api-gateway dashboard.
- add runbook quick action to bump timeouts and scale pools.

lia: agree. also add a short-term synthetic probe hitting /v1/complete and measuring end-to-end latency so we can detect slow upstreams before gateway timeouts.

mike: drafting prometheus rules now. rough sketch: `HighApiGateway5xx` with `for: 6m` and separate `GatewayTimeoutDominance` that checks ratio of (502|504)/total_5xx > 0.45. will open PR.

samir: please include link to runbook steps in alert annotations. auto-remediation is risky here, so keep manual ops but with clear steps.

julia: also schedule a 30m postmortem sync in #eng-sre for later today to discuss alert fatigue and permanent thresholds. Lia please own customer-impact notes.

lia: noted. I'll collate customer tickets and draft summary. severity: SEV2 due to retries for paying customers but no data loss.

mike: PRs: #412 alert tuning, #413 grafana panels, #414 timeout-runbook. linking when ready.

samir: handing off to julia for night in 10m. status: mitigated, timeout bumped, alerts silenced, follow-ups tracked.

julia: taking watch. I'll deploy the monitoring PRs to staging tonight and confirm thresholds in the morning. thanks team :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: samir -> julia. Reminder: file incident summary and update runbook.

ops-bot: Incident state: mitigated. Metrics steady for 12m.

julia: locking thread for now; we'll reconvene for the postmortem. if anything spikes re-open. :lock:

oncall-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) by julia.
